title: Minecraft XP
blurb: Bubbling, plentiful and weirdly moreish, the XP orb sound is Minecraft's finest small reward. Each orb ticks in with its own little chirp, so a decent haul arrives as a cascade rather than a single note — the audio equivalent of coins pouring out of a machine. That is deliberate design: the game turns a bare number going up into something you can physically feel. Play it whenever you learn something, close a ticket, or want a mundane achievement to register as measurable progress towards enchanting a pickaxe you will then be far too precious to use.
origin: The experience-orb collection sound from Minecraft.
